Ready2Send is a utility application that helps users prepare supported online video links for sharing through WhatsApp.

We do not guarantee that every supported URL will always be successfully processed.
6. Temporary Processing
When you submit a URL, Ready2Send may temporarily download and store the requested video on its backend server so that it can be returned to your device.
